headline: Original BF16 fits on H100, but neither completed configuration sustains two 25 FPS streams.

incomplete_runs.h100-paired-fp8-dynamic-regional-a689e6f: Canceled during decoder warmup after local session interruption; no measured FPS or quality conclusion.

notes: Original BF16: 1.388 s median pair generation, 1.554 s with amortized decoding, approximately 20.60 FPS per request; peak generation allocation 44.66 GiB.
FP8 storage / BF16 compute: 1.459 s median pair generation, 1.624 s with amortized decoding, approximately 19.70 FPS per request; peak generation allocation 27.43 GiB.
Removing FP8 storage improves batched throughput by about 4.5%, but generation alone still exceeds the 1.28 s deadline. This is not a completed realtime serving implementation.

Output equivalence is not established. BF16 batched vs alternating latent relative RMS differences are 54.2% and 82.7%. Sampled frames show changed motion; batched request 1 partly exits the frame near 5.12 s.

Even the alternating FP8 harness differs from the original single-request control: 43.6% whole-video latent relative RMS. The first conditioned latent is identical and differences grow afterwards; the exact cause has not been isolated. These numbers are not perceptual quality scores.

Four small CPU regression tests passed, including per-request sigma, strict graph capture, gated attention, and cache populate/reuse with both RoPE layouts. Completed full GPU runs recorded no graph breaks or non-finite outputs.
Both precisions use the same paired harness, inputs, checkpoint, dimensions and scheduling. The single-request control is a separate pipeline measurement, not proof of identical output.
Native FP8 matrix multiplication was interrupted during decoder warmup. Warmup timings are excluded; no native FP8 result is claimed.

Decoder numbers amortize full-clip decoding. Text/image/audio preparation, encoding and network delivery are outside paired chunk timing. Short 10.28-second clips do not establish long-session stability.

All GPU benchmark apps are stopped. Conservative accounting, including failures and interruptions: 2.151 H100-hours of the authorized 5. This is an upper bound from app lifetimes plus margins, not a billing reading.
